entities.name: Query UbiE methyltransferase
observations: 243 aa soluble protein; predicted molecular mass 27.37 kDa and pI 5.50.
Contains Pfam Ubie_methyltran (PF01209.25), positions 16–242, with strong i-Evalue 7.1e-76.
Has 63.9% identity and 99.2% query coverage to reviewed Zymomonas mobilis UbiE Q9X3X2.
Sequence-based evidence supports a SAM-dependent quinone C-methyltransferase, but exact substrate scope is inferred from homologs.

entities.name: UbiE Q9X3X2
observations: Reviewed UbiE from Zymomonas mobilis; 63.9% identity to the query over essentially the full length.
Annotated with EC 2.1.1.163 and EC 2.1.1.201 for menaquinone and ubiquinone-pathway C-methyltransferase activities.
Uses S-adenosyl-L-methionine as methyl donor in curated reaction mappings RHEA:42640 and RHEA:28286.

entities.name: UbiE DMQH2 methylation
observations: Mapped to Rhea RHEA:28286; associated EC 2.1.1.201.

entities.name: UbiE demethylmenaquinol methylation
observations: Mapped to Rhea RHEA:42640; associated EC 2.1.1.163.

entities.name: SAM methyl donor
observations: UbiE homolog annotations identify S-adenosyl-L-methionine (SAM) as the methyl donor and S-adenosyl-L-homocysteine as the coproduct.
